# Grafana Secrets Manager API

This is simple API to store and retrieve secrets. Note that common
operations are supported (add, update, delete list) as well as requesting
the plain text version of a secret. The operations are accessible based on
the scopes of the secret used to access the API.

## API Reference

### Grafana Secrets Manager API

Path: `/api.html`
Version: 0.0.1

This is simple API to store and retrieve secrets. Note that common
operations are supported (add, update, delete list) as well as requesting
the plain text version of a secret. The operations are accessible based on
the scopes of the secret used to access the API.

#### Operations

##### GET /secrets

Summary: Retrieve all secrets

Returns a list of secrets

Responses:
- 200: A list of secrets with metadata
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Not allowed

##### POST /secrets

Summary: Add a new secret

Add a new secret

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201: A single secret with metadata
- 400: Invalid input
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Not allowed
- 422: Validation exception

##### GET /secrets/find_by_labels

Summary: Finds secrets by labels

Multiple labels can be provided with comma separated strings.

Responses:
- 200: A list of secrets with metadata
- 400: Invalid tag value
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Not allowed

##### GET /secrets/{id}

Summary: Find secret by ID

Returns a single secret

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required) - ID of secret to return

Responses:
- 200: A single secret with metadata
- 400: Invalid ID supplied
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Not allowed
- 404: Secret not found

##### PUT /secrets/{id}

Summary: Update an existing secret

Update an existing secret by Id

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required) - ID of secret to update

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 202: A single secret with metadata
- 400: Invalid ID supplied
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Not allowed
- 404: Secret not found
- 422: Validation exception

##### DELETE /secrets/{id}

Summary: Deletes a secret

delete a secret

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required) - Secret id to delete

Responses:
- 200: A successful operation
- 400: Invalid secret value
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Not allowed

##### GET /secrets/{id}/decrypt

Summary: Decrypt the specified secret

Returns the secret with the plaintext value set

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required) - ID of secret to decrypt

Responses:
- 200: A single secret with metadata and the secret value as plaintext.
- 400: Invalid ID supplied
- 401: Unauthorized
- 403: Not allowed
- 404: Secret not found

#### Models

- CommonSecretProperties
- SecretMetadata
- Secret
- SecretWithMetadata
- DecryptedSecret
- Label
- ApiResponse
